line_text: sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Hostname < out[j].Hostname })

quotes.text: This was originally added to support a second set of host/vips for Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Services (MCS). We've since gone with a different approach and this is no longer needed.
quotes.author: Nathan Mittler
quotes.title: Remove ClusterLocal structure from Service (#35321)

quotes.text: This is laying the groundwork for future features:
quotes.author: Nathan Mittler
quotes.title: Support multiple hosts and Cluster VIPs (#34818)

quotes.text:
- IPv6, which requires that services support multiple cluster VIPs.
- MCS, which requires a separate host and cluster VIP for the clusterset.

medium: The history reveals this sorting logic initially supported multiple host/VIPs for MCS and IPv6, and was later removed due to a different approach.

card.what: This line sorts a slice of service objects based on their hostnames.
card.why: Initially, this sorting was added to accommodate Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Services (MCS) which needed distinct host and VIP configurations for each cluster [1][2]. The code suggests this was intended as a foundation for future features like IPv6 support, which necessitates multiple cluster VIPs [2][3].
card.next: Before making any changes, verify if this sorting is still required by any other parts of the system, even if it's no longer explicitly used in the core logic.

answer: The sort makes the service list order deterministic; tests (and possibly NDS) depend on that order.
